plugins.name: specclaw
plugins.description: Lean, output-first spec-driven builds: mock first, then propose, plan, build, verify, pr.

plugins.name: specclaw-bf
plugins.description: Brownfield rebuild add-on for specclaw: analyze, clarify, baseline, replay and rebuild a legacy app.

plugins.name: specclaw-sync
plugins.description: Tracker sync add-on for specclaw: GitHub issues, Azure DevOps boards and PRs, Jira.

plugins.name: specclaw-extras
plugins.description: Optional specclaw skills: auto, loop, learn, patterns, context, author-spec, debug, renumber and the review panel.

plugins.name: specclaw-review
plugins.description: Local review loop for specclaw: layered review rules, converging rounds, a bounded review memory behind an MCP server.

plugins.name: specclaw-fleet
plugins.description: Fleet add-on for specclaw: run approved changes headless in sandboxed K3s jobs with Claude or Codex on the work-item assignee's own plan, tracked in Azure Boards.

plugins.name: specclaw-dash
plugins.description: Dashboard mod for specclaw in Claude Code: one /dash pane for the build, review and learning loops and token use (API-equivalent estimate), with actions that run existing commands: launch fleet runs, approve lessons, edit context caps, undo dismissed tips.
